guaikei-xhs-notes-and-comments 1.0.0

- Initial release with support for searching and analyzing public Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) notes and comments.
- Enables keyword-based search, note detail and comment retrieval, and monitoring of public posts by specific creators.
- Includes a step-by-step decision tree for handling user input scenarios (keywords, note links, user profile links, shortened links, and general requests).
- Provides clear validation and error-handling guidance, ensuring robust command execution and structured results output.
- Focused on public data only; does not support login, posting, interaction, or accessing private content.
